_comment: ROUTED CREATURES GO STRAIGHT TO OPENROUTER, NEVER COMFYUI (enforced in tools/generate-token-art.mjs; override only with an explicit --backend=comfyui). Persistent ComfyUI failure classes: hybrid/composite bodies (centaur, owlbear, drider, hydra, multi-headed giants), absent features that diffusion cannot omit (blank/faceless faces, headless, one-eyed cyclops), incorporeal ghosts drawn solid, and oozes drawn with faces. 'ids' lists specific creature ids confirmed to fail; 'keywords'/'kinds' catch the rest by name. Gemini is out of credits (2026-10-01), so every route resolves to the OpenRouter chain (Muse, Flux klein, Krea). Earlier derivation notes: Names/kinds routed to the Gemini backend FIRST (skip ComfyUI). Derived from docs/token-art-failures.csv (ComfyUI-first rows only) and docs/token-art-history/ via tools/analyze-art-failures.mjs [--history]; extend only when a group has n>=4 and a first-pass flag rate >=60%, or is a documented systematic failure. Adopted: hybrid (7/9), dragon (25/41, incl. young 8/13 and spellcaster 13/21), owlbear, storm/sky concepts (history). Undead adopted 2026-09-29 for the Book of the Dead pack (#241) on a near-threshold 5/9 (56%) ComfyUI flag rate plus the pack being ~all undead/incorporeal, where ComfyUI historically drew scenery/halos; revisit with data. Elemental adopted 2026-09-30 for the Rage of Elements pack (#285): scenery-implying subjects (fire, water, wind, storm) that history shows ComfyUI fills with backdrops; the earlier sample was 2/3 flagged (n=3). Watch: fey (3/5). Gemini-first: 13/14 accepted on the first try (nue, a hybrid, needed a retry).
